description: Bộ kịch bản hội thoại tự xây dựng để kiểm tra phép gộp nhiều tin nhắn. Nhãn 'expect' là trạng thái stress ở tin nhắn CUỐI, do người soạn gán, không phải nhãn từ bộ dữ liệu chuẩn.

messages: I have three exams this week and I cannot sleep because I am so anxious about failing.
Actually I just talked to my teacher and she said I am well prepared, so I feel calm and relieved now.
My boss yelled at me again today and I feel completely overwhelmed and exhausted at work.
But then my team brought me coffee and we laughed together, and now I feel much better and happy.
I have been crying all evening because I feel like nothing is going right in my life.
Then my best friend came over and we watched a movie, and I feel safe and a lot lighter now.
I am panicking about rent, I do not know how I will pay it this month and my chest feels tight.
Good news, my mom just sent me the money, so the problem is solved and I can finally breathe.
I failed my driving test today and I feel so ashamed and angry at myself.
I booked a new test for next week and I feel hopeful and motivated to try again.
I am terrified about the presentation tomorrow and my hands will not stop shaking.
I practiced it twice with my friends and they loved it, so I feel confident and excited now.
I had a lovely walk in the park this morning and I feel relaxed and happy.
Just got a call from the hospital, my father is in the emergency room and I am shaking with fear and cannot think straight.
Today was a good day, I finished my project and went out for dinner with friends.
I just found out I am being laid off tomorrow and I feel sick with worry about how I will survive.
I am enjoying my holiday and everything is peaceful and calm.
My landlord just told me I have a week to leave the flat and I am panicking, I have nowhere to go.
I feel great, I passed my exam and I am celebrating with my family.
Now my girlfriend says she wants to break up and I feel devastated, I cannot stop crying.
Things are going well at work lately and I am in a good mood.
My manager just called a meeting about my performance and I am so scared I might lose everything I worked for.
I slept well and woke up feeling rested and ready for the day.
I received a threatening message and I feel unsafe, anxious and I cannot concentrate on anything at all.
I cannot sleep anymore and I am constantly worried about money and my future.
The worry keeps getting worse, I feel exhausted, overwhelmed and I do not know how to cope with all this pressure.
My workload is crushing me and I feel like I am drowning every single day.
I snapped at my coworker today and now I feel guilty and even more stressed, I am at my breaking point.
I am so anxious about the exams that my stomach hurts all the time.
I studied all night and still feel unprepared, my heart races and I feel like I am going to fail everything.
Ever since the argument with my parents I feel tense and cannot relax at all.
They are still not speaking to me and I feel alone, stressed and unable to focus on anything.
I am under so much pressure to find a job and every rejection hurts more.
Another rejection email today, I feel hopeless and constantly on edge, I am running out of savings.
I feel overwhelmed taking care of my sick mother while working full time.
I am so tired and stressed that I cry every night, I feel I cannot keep this up any longer.
I had a relaxing weekend at the beach with my family and I feel happy.
We cooked together tonight and laughed a lot, I am grateful and in a very good mood.
I started a new hobby, painting, and I am really enjoying it.
I finished my first painting today and I feel proud and calm, life is good at the moment.
My day was pretty ordinary, I went to class and then to the gym.
Afterwards I had dinner with a friend and we talked about movies, it was a nice and easy evening.
I adopted a puppy last week and he makes me smile every day.
We went for a long walk today and I feel peaceful, cheerful and full of energy.
I got a small promotion at work and my team congratulated me.
I feel satisfied and optimistic about the coming months, everything is going smoothly.
I am looking forward to the weekend trip with my friends.
We packed everything and I feel excited and relaxed, it is going to be a lot of fun.
